title: Deterministic experiments and configuration

objectives.text: Use an isolated seeded RNGand bounded versioned configuration to replay a synthetic resampling computation without mutating global random state.
Build a deterministic content manifest for data/config/runtime/kernel tag,and separate replay identity from source authenticity,statistical validity and cross-version promises.

blocks.markdown: An experiment is a declared question,data snapshot,code/configuration,selection protocol,runtime and result,not only a seed. Record units,time/universe filters,cost/fill policy,dependencies/hardware relevant to numerics,random streams,threading and failures. A later changed input/configuration is a new experiment,not an overwrite of the old result. Keep results and diagnostics tied to the actual evaluated manifest. This example is a tiny empirical resampling demonstration,not a strategy backtest or a statistical return forecast.

A local random.Random(seed)instance isolates a pseudorandom stream from unrelated calls to Python's global generator. The seed identifies a stream only with the algorithm/runtime and sequence of calls;changing loop order or adding draws can change results. Python documents limits on cross-version reproducibility;randrangeand other algorithms may change. Record the actual tested Python runtime rather than promise every future version emits the same resamples. Pseudorandom reproducibility is not cryptographic randomness or evidence of independent market returns.

steps.text: Data are synthetic returns in integer basis points[10,-5,20]. Config is version1,seed7,resamples4. For each resample,draw3indexes with replacement and store their integer sum;the mean is sum/3bps,not the sum itself.

Serialize a manifest containing data,config,kernel tag and actual Python version using sorted keys,explicit separators/encoding and no nonfinite values. Reordering dict insertion does not change those bytes or digest.

Changing a datum,seed,budget or runtime should change the content record. The SHA256digest is a content identity aid,not a guarantee of mathematical validity,source code authenticity or historical availability. Keep the separately checked source/build hash and trusted source provenance alongside it.

blocks.caption: Expected Python3.12.15sums(0,40,25,50),denominator3;replay True;global RNGindependent True;changed data identity True;invalid experiment config keys. Complete code stores exact resample totals and denominator,avoiding silent bps/mean confusion. Kernel tag must be bound to the actual reviewed source/build hash outside this toy manifest. It returns data in memory only,no persisted run registry,result signature,parallel stream assignment or cross-version randrangeguarantee.

blocks.markdown: Drawing individual rows with replacement treats observations as exchangeable iid empirical draws. Financial series often have serial dependence,changing volatility,overlapping labels and regime shifts. This code does not establish a valid time-series bootstrap confidence interval. Block/stationary/other dependence-aware methods need justified resampling units and tuning,and still cannot invent unseen regimes. Do not label exact deterministic resample output as statistical coverage or future-return evidence.

Canonical JSONhere means explicit stable serialization under this restricted string-key/integer/list schema,not a universal canonicalization standard for arbitrary objects/floats/dates/Unicode. Python's built-in hash()is not an archival digest substitute. SHA256collision risk is not the main workflow danger:wrong inputs,unrecorded filters,ambiguous units and a stale success label can all produce confidently repeatable wrong results. Keep schema validation and human/source review separate.

For parallel experiments,assign recorded independent/appropriate child streams to stable task IDs rather than letting scheduling choose which worker consumes the next global draw. A repeated seed on every worker can duplicate samples instead of providing independent replications. Floating reductions across threads/hardware may differ even with the same seed;state tolerances/deterministic settings. Our bounded sequential integer-sum example avoids those specific effects butdoes not solve general distributed reproducibility.

A replay check compares the exact data/config/runtime/code/result protocol,not only a final rounded score. Retain failed/excluded attempts and reason codes,especially when search decisions depend on them. A failed run should not reuse a previous run's success metadata. Result completion and durable/atomic publication are separate from a pure function returning a value;later lessons handle local artifacts and recovery. No network service or paid system is involved.

Independent transfer:reorder config keys and verify identical canonical bytes/result;change one data value or seed and record the distinct manifest. Perturb global RNGstate and verify this local stream does not change;also verify the function itself leaves global state untouched. Reconstruct each small resample from saved index draws in an independent checker. Explain why repeated identical output establishes replay butnot iid assumptions or a confidence interval for tomorrow's return.

Sources:[Python3.12random/reproducibility](https://docs.python.org/3.12/library/random.html),[JSONexplicit serialization options](https://docs.python.org/3.12/library/json.html),[hashlibSHA256bytes API](https://docs.python.org/3.12/library/hashlib.html). Retrieved3.12documentation may show a newer patch level than the tested3.12.15runtime;the actual fixture runtime is recorded separately. Own resampling/manifest contract is not an external standard.

summary: Replay needs exact data/config/code/runtime and isolated random streams,not a seed alone. A deterministic manifest digest aids content identity butdoes not authenticate inputs or validate iid/dependence assumptions. This sequential integer resample is not a time-series interval or durable experiment platform.
